priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup callback
findings.body: Calling the callback returned by attach no longer removes the registered message handler. Consumers that detach or reattach will continue receiving messages, potentially causing duplicate processing and retaining handlers and their captured state for the socket lifetime.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on at line 2, while the returned callback at changed line 3 is empty. The base-to-head diff specifically removes socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup leaves the listener active and repeated attach/cleanup cycles can retain handlers and duplicate message processing.
